verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP feature docs mention replying to customers as part of workflow actions ('reply to customers') without leaving the LLM, implying reply capability tied to feedback records, but there's no direct documentation of a native in-app 'reply from feedback record' UI feature separate from the MCP/AI workflow. missing for 10: dedicated in-app reply/close-the-loop UI documentation, evidence of email/notification delivery to customers, independent confirmation of this working in the core product (not just via MCP/LLM).
